chunks: I asked Abā ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام about the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Those who say, ‘Our Lord is Allah,’ then remain steadfast.”
So Abū ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام said: “They remained steadfast upon the Imams, one after another.”
“The angels descend upon them: ‘Do not fear, nor grieve, and receive glad tidings of the Paradise which you were promised.’”

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams as the divinely appointed leaders
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who bring reassurance and glad tidings

ai.seo_question: What does “then remained steadfast” mean in relation to the Imams in this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration explains the Qur’anic phrase about steadfastness as steadfastness upon the Imams, one after another. It links true constancy in faith with wilayah and presents the descent of the angels and the glad tidings of Paradise as the outcome of that steadfastness.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Abu Ayoub, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, 
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[41:30] (As for) those who say: Our Lord is Allah, then are steadfast
. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Being steadfast upon the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, one after one
the Angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not, nor be grieved, and receive good news of the Paradise which you were Promised’.
en.sarwar: 40. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Muhammad ibn Fudayl from abu Hamza who has said the following. “I asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High. “Say, ‘I advise you to believe only in One God . .” [34:46]

The Imam (a.s.) said that Allah has said, “I advise you to acknowledge Imam Ali’s Leadership with Divine Authority. It is the one that Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has called, “‘I advise you to believe only in One.”
